AniLumos stable release trigger
Version v1.0.3 (versionCode 13)
Changes: Simkl and Discord account connections; avoid crashes during sign-in.
Publish exactly one universal, signed mobile APK after tests, lint, OAuth configuration,
zip alignment, package/version identity and release-certificate verification succeed.
Use the existing production signing key. Do not overwrite previous stable releases.
Keep preview and Android TV releases in the separate experimental repository.
